prompt.value: How many asterisks does the following code print

i = -3
while (i <= 13):
   print('**')
   print('*')
   i = i + 1

explanation.value:
In every iteration 3 asterisks will be printed, 17 iterations happens, hence 17 * 3 = 51 asterisks will
be printed.
